primary_metric: Macro mean recovery@16 over cases after averaging seeds; skeleton cells are compared against the frozen parent-strata v1 cells (official, unstratified, edge_count, parent_set) stored under runs/parent-dev.
split_rule: Identical case IDs and seed schedule as the frozen parent-strata v1 protocol. This file is a development pilot: both skeleton variants run on the dev split only, and exactly one variant is frozen for the test split before any test inference.
